summary.es: Unas 60 apps para todos los usuarios: Noticias, Tiempo, Clipchamp, Solitaire, Teams personal, Copilot, Outlook (nuevo), Office Hub, To Do, Mapas, Dev Home, Widgets, Skype, Correo y Calendar antiguos, y las patrocinadas (Candy Crush, TikTok, Facebook, Disney+...). Se quedan Fotos, Paint, Bloc de notas, Recortes, Calculadora, Cámara y la Store.
summary.en: About 60 apps for all users: News, Weather, Clipchamp, Solitaire, personal Teams, Copilot, Outlook (new), Office Hub, To Do, Maps, Dev Home, Widgets, Skype, old Mail and Calendar, and the sponsored ones (Candy Crush, TikTok, Facebook, Disney+...). Photos, Paint, Notepad, Snipping Tool, Calculator, Camera and the Store stay.

note.es: No se puede deshacer desde el panel.
note.en: Can't be undone from the panel.
